selection_split: train (n=4797); hard constraints confirmed on validation (n=798); test split not scored
criterion: hard constraints on train and validation: critical sensitivity 100%, 0 false discharges, 0 invariant violations
ties within 0.1 point: higher training macro F1, then fewer switches changed from v1

provenance.g1_graded: ESI handbook: level 1 = immediate life-saving intervention (hypotension, extreme heart rate, hypoxaemia, depressed consciousness); stroke symptoms and hypertensive crisis = level 2
provenance.g4_central_only: TiTrATE/HINTS: central signs or focal deficits warrant emergent work-up; a peripheral HINTS pattern argues against stroke
provenance.g5_age: the surrogate's age cut-offs (>70, <50) have no guideline source; age enters through G2 (ABCD2-style age > 60 point)
provenance.g5_cap: design choice: uncertainty may escalate a prediction but not, by itself, into the critical band; critical uncertainty is expressed by abstention
provenance.vacuous_negatives: absence of a red flag (G1) or a complete record (G3) is not evidence of a benign course: vacuous belief (confidence 0)
provenance.theta_min_mass: simple (1/2) or qualified (2/3) confidence-weighted majority; margin of half or one tier
